entries.text: Brand: TestCo. Error code: T1, T 1, T-1. Meaning: [FAKE] Dusty filter warning (fictional). Customers say: weak airflow; ac thanda nahi kar raha; hawa kam aa rahi hai. Likely causes: clogged filter; blocked airflow.

user_checks: Switch off and clean the filter

entries.text: Brand: TestCo. Error code: T2, T 2, T-2. Meaning: [FAKE] Routine service due reminder (fictional). Customers say: service reminder blinking; service wali light on hai. Likely causes: service interval reached; dirty coils.

user_checks: Note the date of last service

entries.text: Brand: TestCo. Error code: T3, T 3, T-3. Meaning: [FAKE] Indoor fan motor fault (fictional). Customers say: indoor fan not spinning; fan chal nahi raha; noise from indoor unit. Likely causes: faulty capacitor; worn motor.

user_checks: Switch off and do not keep running the unit

entries.text: Brand: TestCo. Error code: T4, T 4, T-4. Meaning: [FAKE] Overheat protection tripped (fictional). Customers say: burning smell; smoke from ac; jalne ki smell aa rahi hai. Likely causes: electrical fault; blocked outdoor unit.

user_checks: Switch off at the main switch
warnings: Do not touch wiring or the outdoor unit
symptoms: jalne ki smell aa rahi hai

entries.text: Brand: TestCo. Model: X100. Error code: T5, T 5, T-5. Meaning: [FAKE] Sensor fault on the X100 series (fictional). Customers say: display shows wrong temperature; temperature galat dikha raha hai. Likely causes: faulty room sensor.

record.meaning: [FAKE] Sensor fault on the X100 series (fictional)

entries.text: Brand: TestCo. Model: Z200. Error code: T5, T 5, T-5. Meaning: [FAKE] Communication fault on the Z200 series (fictional). Customers say: not cooling; outdoor unit not starting; bahar wala unit start nahi ho raha. Likely causes: loose indoor-outdoor wiring; PCB fault.

record.meaning: [FAKE] Communication fault on the Z200 series (fictional)
user_checks: Check the outdoor unit has power
symptoms: bahar wala unit start nahi ho raha

entries.text: Brand: FakeAir. Error code: F-12, F12, F 12. Meaning: [FAKE] Water leak detected (fictional). Customers say: water dripping from indoor unit; paani tapak raha hai; ac se paani gir raha hai. Likely causes: blocked drain pipe; frozen coil.

user_checks: Switch off and place a tray under the unit
symptoms: ac se paani gir raha hai

entries.text: Brand: FakeAir. Error code: F-99, F99, F 99. Meaning: [FAKE] Unreviewed record that must NOT be published (fictional). Customers say: test only. Likely causes: unknown.

record.meaning: [FAKE] Unreviewed record that must NOT be published (fictional)
